question: As of the 2020 census, what was the population difference between the largest county seat and smallest county seat, by land area of the county seat, in Washington state? For population figures, please use the official data from data.census.gov. Please report the integer difference.

- Identify largest and smallest by land area.
- Pull 2020 Decennial (PL 94-171) population from data.census.gov for those two cities/towns.
- Compute integer difference.

mistake_reason: At step 20, the WebSurfer agent unilaterally declared themselves the lead decision-maker and overrode the orchestrator’s plan by finalizing the selection of Spokane (as largest) and Asotin (as smallest) without required confirmation and contrary to prior analysis indicating Seattle as the largest by land area and Cathlamet as the smallest. This violated role boundaries (Disobey Role Specification) by making final strategic decisions outside the browsing role’s remit and instructing the team to proceed, leading to the wrong pair and hence the wrong population difference.
